queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(CASE WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL
                  THEN derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price END) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_overall
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND product_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING SUM(product_price) <> 0
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_overall
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / AVG(product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING AVG(product_price) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(derived_total_cost) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_diff_above_overall
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS overall_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.overall_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_overall
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.overall_ratio;
